In each column show ONE clear full-body three-quarter pose plus TWO small expressive portrait studies and their unique prop. Clean silhouette, all feet visible, no overlapping characters. Pale subtle dividers, fine art book layout. No title, no writing, no labels, no speech bubbles, no UI, no watermark. Each character must be different and recognizable at small scale. Left column TISH: adult male goblin, compact adventurous build, one ear has a tiny notch, short brown leaf-shaped hair tuft, coral red triangular scarf, simple dark leather tunic and small satchel, tentative heroic smile. Portraits: determined and embarrassed. Middle column LUMA: adult female goblin pathfinder, confident capable equal partner, short dark green braid, teal neckerchief with bronze leaf clasp, practical cream shirt and brown trousers, small folded trail map, upright warm expression. Right column BUM: adult male goblin gentle giant, 1.4 times Tish's height, broad rounded shoulders, moss green skin, ochre sleeveless vest and huge soft backpack, big gentle face, carefully holding a tiny wedding garland without breaking it. Portraits: puzzled and joyful. No weapons, no baby-like adults, no sexualized design.
